description: This file generates a keyword-based bar chart for test plan metrics within the TestLink open source testing framework. It initializes configuration, retrieves data related to keywords and their statuses, and creates a chart visualization based on this data.

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: A class used to retrieve metrics data related to test plans, specifically status totals by keyword.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: A class representing input parameters, with string and integer types.

methods.name: getDataAndScale
methods.description: Retrieves keyword data and scales for chart rendering, processing test plan metrics by keyword and status.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes arguments for data retrieval, managing access rights and session variables.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view test plan metrics.
